mapper.sql: t.execution_input_uuid AS uuid, t.organization_uuid, t.workspace_uuid, t.session_uuid, t.execution_input_uuid AS input_event_uuid, t.execution->>'state' AS state, CAST(t.execution->>'worker_epoch' AS bigint) AS worker_epoch, CAST(t.execution->>'attempts' AS integer) AS attempts, t.execution->>'task_uuid' AS task_uuid, t.execution->>'tool_uuid' AS tool_uuid, t.execution->>'task_kind' AS task_kind, t.execution->>'subagent_thread_uuid' AS subagent_thread_uuid, t.execution->>'delegation_tool_uuid' AS delegation_tool_uuid, t.execution->>'resume_input_uuid' AS resume_input_uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO harness_thread_state AS t ( organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, thread_uuid, execution_input_uuid, execution) SELECT s.organization_uuid, s.workspace_uuid, s.uuid, s.uuid, i.input_uuid, jsonb_build_object('state', 'pending', 'worker_epoch', 0, 'attempts', 0, 'task_kind', '') FROM harness_inputs i JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = i.session_uuid WHERE i.input_uuid = #{ref.UUID} AND s.organization_uuid = #{ref.OrganizationUUID} AND s.workspace_uuid = #{ref.WorkspaceUUID} AND s.uuid = #{ref.SessionUUID} AND i.state = 'queued' ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, session_uuid, thread_uuid) DO UPDATE SET execution_input_uuid = EXCLUDED.execution_input_uuid, execution = EXCLUDED.execution WHERE t.execution_input_uuid IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.execution_input_uuid AND (t.execution IS NULL OR t.execution->>'state' IN ('completed', 'failed', 'interrupted')) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE harness_thread_state SET execution = CASE WHEN CAST(#{params.State} AS text) = 'interrupted' THEN execution - 'wake_pending' ELSE execution END || jsonb_build_object( 'state', CAST(#{params.State} AS text), 'task_uuid', CAST(#{params.TaskUUID} AS text), 'tool_uuid', CAST(#{params.ToolUUID} AS text), 'task_kind', CAST(#{params.Kind} AS text), 'lease_until', NULL, 'model_started_at', NULL, 'attempts', 0, 'subagent_thread_uuid', NULL, 'delegation_tool_uuid', NULL) WHERE thread_uuid = session_uuid AND execution_input_uuid = #{params.Ref.UUID} AND organization_uuid = #{params.Ref.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{params.Ref.WorkspaceUUID} AND session_uuid = #{params.Ref.SessionUUID} AND execution->>'state' IN ('pending', 'running', 'waiting_choice', 'waiting_tool')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM harness_thread_state t WHERE FOR UPDATE OF t

SELECT FROM harness_thread_state t WHERE t.organization_uuid = #{ref.OrganizationUUID} AND t.workspace_uuid = #{ref.WorkspaceUUID} AND t.session_uuid = #{ref.SessionUUID} AND t.thread_uuid = t.session_uuid AND t.execution_input_uuid IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE OF t

SELECT FROM harness_thread_state t WHERE t.organization_uuid = #{ref.OrganizationUUID} AND t.workspace_uuid = #{ref.WorkspaceUUID} AND t.session_uuid = #{ref.SessionUUID} AND t.thread_uuid = t.session_uuid AND t.execution->>'state' = 'waiting_choice' FOR UPDATE OF t
mapper.update: UPDATE harness_thread_state t SET execution = execution || jsonb_build_object( 'state', 'pending', 'task_kind', 'model', 'task_uuid', CAST(#{taskUUID} AS text), 'resume_input_uuid', CAST(#{taskUUID} AS text), 'resume_input_kind', 'choice_response', 'wake_pending', true) WHERE AND t.execution->>'state' = 'waiting_choice'

UPDATE harness_thread_state SET execution = execution || jsonb_build_object( 'state', 'waiting_tool', 'lease_until', NULL, 'resume_input_uuid', CAST(#{toolUUID} AS text), 'resume_input_kind', 'tool_result', 'wake_pending', true) WHERE AND execution->>'task_kind' = 'tool' AND execution->>'tool_uuid' = #{toolUUID}
mapper.select: SELECT t.execution_input_uuid AS uuid, t.organization_uuid, t.workspace_uuid, t.session_uuid, t.execution->>'resume_input_uuid' AS resume_input_uuid, t.execution->>'resume_input_kind' AS resume_input_kind FROM harness_thread_state t WHERE t.execution->>'wake_pending' = 'true' AND ( t.execution->>'state' = 'pending' OR (t.execution->>'state' = 'waiting_tool' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sandbox_tool_calls call JOIN code_sessions cs ON cs.uuid = call.code_session_uuid AND cs.workspace_uuid = call.workspace_uuid AND cs.organization_uuid = call.organization_uuid WHERE cs.session_uuid = t.session_uuid AND call.workspace_uuid = t.workspace_uuid AND call.organization_uuid = t.organization_uuid AND call.external_id = t.execution->>'resume_input_uuid' AND call.state IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired', 'lost') )) ) ORDER BY t.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE harness_thread_state t SET execution = execution - 'wake_pending' WHERE AND t.execution->>'resume_input_uuid' = #{inputUUID} AND t.execution->>'wake_pending' = 'true'

UPDATE code_sessions SET oauth_access_token_hash = #{params.TokenHash,sensitive=true}, current_worker_epoch = current_worker_epoch + 1, worker_lease_expires_at = #{params.LeaseUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{params.CodeSessionUUID} AND organization_uuid = #{params.Ref.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{params.Ref.WorkspaceUUID} AND session_uuid = #{params.Ref.SessionUUID} AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (worker_lease_expires_at IS NULL OR worker_lease_expires_at <= NOW()) RETURNING current_worker_epoch
